word-day-24h.gl: a full day of 24 hours, day and night together

word-day-off.def: a day when you do not have to go to work or school

word-working-day.def: a day on which most people go to work, usually Monday to Friday

word-on-time.def: at the right moment, not late and not early

word-date-of-birth.def: the day, month and year when a person was born

word-time-zone.def: an area of the world where all clocks show the same hour

word-o-clock.def: a word used after a number to say the exact hour on a clock

word-lifetime.def: the whole period during which a person lives

word-hogmanay.gl: Hogmanay: Scottish New Year's Eve celebration with first-footing and Auld Lang Syne
